name: John Forester
bio: a Representative from Tennessee; born in McMinnville, Warren County, Tenn., birth date unknown; received a limited schooling; studied law; admitted to the bar and practiced; elected as a Jacksonian candidate to the Twenty-third Congress and reelected as an Anti-Jacksonian candidate to the Twenty-fourth Congress (March 4, 1833-March 3, 1837); died August 31, 1845.
